newsitem.title: THAILAND: TRIS downgrades Property Perfect rating.
newsitem.headline: TRIS downgrades Property Perfect rating.

text.p: Thai Rating and Information Services (TRIS) on Friday downgraded Property Perfect Plc's debenture rating to "BB+" from "BBB", saying it reflected increasing business risks in the depressed Thai property sector.

The Thai credit rating agency said the lower rating for Property Perfect's 3.3 billion baht debentures was based on its current weak financial profile stemming from high leverage and past rapid business expansion.
TRIS said Property Perfect's overall business position is determined essentially by its ability to deliver completed housing units to buyers amid a sustained depressed market.
It said, however, that the company still has overall good asset quality, enjoys solid market position and possesses managerial skill in low-rise residential development.
TRIS said Property Perfect's outstanding debts rose to about 10.8 billion baht ($432 million) in June with a total debt to capitalisation ratio of 68.5 percent.
The agency said the company's backlog of uncompleted housing units stood at 3,029, worth 7.9 billion baht, in August. The company planned to deliver units valued about 2.8 billion baht this year.
